route_variants.title: Roof Repair
route_variants.intro: Your roof protects your home from the elements, but over time, wear and tear, harsh weather, and general aging can cause damage. At {{business_name}}, we provide expert roof repairs to restore your roof's integrity and keep your home safe.

route_variants.title: Guttering
route_variants.intro: Gutters play a crucial role in directing rainwater away from your home, preventing foundation issues, dampness, and structural damage. At {{business_name}}, we offer expert guttering services, from new installations to repairs and maintenance.

route_variants.title: Chimney Repair
route_variants.intro: Chimneys are constantly exposed to harsh weather, which can cause cracks, leaks, and structural damage over time. At {{business_name}}, we offer expert chimney repair services to keep your chimney functional and safe.

route_variants.title: New Roofs
route_variants.intro: A new roof is a significant investment that enhances your home's safety, energy efficiency, and visual appeal. At {{business_name}}, we provide expert new roof installations tailored to your property's style.

route_variants.title: Flat Roofs
route_variants.intro: Flat roofs are a practical and modern choice for extensions, garages, and commercial properties. At {{business_name}}, we specialise in high-quality flat roofing solutions and repairs.

route_variants.title: Fascia & Soffits
route_variants.intro: Fascia and soffits protect the roofline from moisture damage while improving the overall appearance of your home. At {{business_name}}, we offer professional fascia and soffit services.

route_variants.title: Power Washing
route_variants.intro: Over time, moss, algae, lichen, and dirt accumulate on roofs, leading to discoloration, damage, and potential drainage issues. At {{business_name}}, we offer professional roof power washing services.

items.question: How long do roof repairs take?
items.answer: It depends on the extent of damage. Minor repairs can be completed in a few hours, while major repairs may take a day or more.

items.question: How do I know if my roof needs repairs?
items.answer: Look for signs such as leaks, damp patches, missing tiles, or sagging areas. A professional inspection can confirm any issues.
